name: liquid-logo

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the full mark with the strongest chrome sheen and a bright rainbow band.

tagline: A black logo mark shimmers like liquid chrome with rainbow edges.
summary: A canvas that renders an image as a glossy, melting surface, bending its shape and adding thin iridescent highlights that drift over it.
appearance: Two interlocking rounded black tiles form an offset plus shape on a dark stage. Their surface looks like polished chrome, with a white sheen and a thin rainbow band running along the inner edges.
behaviour: The chrome surface ripples continuously, sliding its bright highlights and rainbow fringes along the shape. The silhouette wobbles slightly but stays recognisable.
demo_content: A neutral mark of two interlocking rounded squares.
use_when: A brand mark should feel premium and moving rather than a static SVG.
avoid_when: It needs a square WebGL canvas and an image with a clean alpha shape to read well.
customise: imageUrl plus patternScale, refraction, edge, patternBlur, liquid, speed and showProcessing are props; the shaders are fixed.
weight_why: A WebGL2 fragment shader redrawn every frame via requestAnimationFrame.

a11y.note: A decorative WebGL canvas with no label, no reduced-motion check and a looping render.

issues: Frame 1 is blank while the logo processes and before the shader draws.
polish_why: Convincing liquid chrome and rainbow edges; the first frame is blank during load.
title: Liquid Logo
